LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Bread.label: date bread
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Bread.description: A round loaf of emmer wheat baked with dates and honey, served with onions, a lump of soft cheese and a cup of thin beer.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Ful.label: ful
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Ful.description: Fava beans stewed slowly with oil, garlic and cumin, eaten with flat bread. The meal of every farmer and every pharaoh.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_DateCake.label: date cakes
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_DateCake.description: Small cakes of ground dates, honey and nuts, baked for temple feasts and given to children on festival days. A small treat: eating it is a little joy.
